# JFrog

> > JFrog is the leading platform for software supply chain automation, enabling secure DevOps and continuous software delivery from code to runtime.

JFrog provides an integrated platform for artifact management, security governance, and AI-driven software delivery. The company serves enterprises seeking to secure and accelerate their software development lifecycle through comprehensive supply chain solutions.

## Key Topics

- Software Supply Chain
- Artifact Management
- DevOps Platform
- Supply Chain Security
- JFrog Artifactory
- JFrog Platform
- JFrog Security
- Risk Management
- Compliance Governance
- AI/ML Deployment
- Code-to-Runtime Security
- Enterprise Solutions
- Software Delivery
- DevOps Security
- Governance
